name: Carry two measurement limits into the claim about a change

uses.action: Open the catch margin on the 9 mm reading, then include the error in its reference ring. The possible interval expands from 8.5–9.5 to 8–10 mm on the slip.
Match a plumb line with a fifty-year-old notch and shade the tolerances on the new and old edges. A central change of zero allows movement of up to one finger-width in either direction.
